note: Cape Verde: a foreigner coming to work, employed or independent, for up to a year, in particular as an artist, takes the temporary visa, used within 180 days and extendable to a year; longer stays convert to a residence visa (Law 66/VIII/2014, art. 34). No days without it. ECOWAS citizens work as nationals do (the ecowas list).

sources.title: Lei n.º 66/VIII/2014, Regime Jurídico de Entrada, Permanência e Saída de Estrangeiros, art. 34 (SNIAC)
